standard_prerequisites: the reduced induced closed subspace structure on a closed subset

closed immersions and finite unions of closed immersions are finite morphisms (Morphisms of Spaces, Lemmas spaces-morphisms-lemma-closed-immersion-finite and spaces-morphisms-lemma-finite-union-finite)
finite morphisms are universally closed and proper (Morphisms of Spaces, Lemma spaces-morphisms-lemma-finite-proper)
the functoriality of properness over the base for the image under a proper morphism (lemma-functoriality-closed-proper-over-base of the same chapter, part (2))
core_obligations: Prove that if T_1,...,T_n are closed subsets of |X| proper over Y, then their union is proper over Y
proof_roadmap: Give each T_i its reduced induced subspace structure Z_i; the induced map from the disjoint union of the Z_i to X is finite.
Finite morphisms are universally closed and the disjoint union of the Z_i is proper over Y.
The functoriality lemma then makes the image, which is the union of the T_i, proper over Y.
difficulty_reason: H2: a finite-morphism argument realizing the union as the image of a proper source.
